From 1914 to 1918, the war moved from outbreak to wider entry and ended with the armistice.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions made a larger war more likely.
The Sarajevo assassination set off the July Crisis, then alliance commitments and mobilization widened the conflict into war.

activities.label: Your own words
activities.title: Explain the outbreak chain
activities.body: In 2 or 3 sentences, explain how the war widened after Sarajevo. Use your own words.
activities.concept: outbreak sequence from Sarajevo to declarations of war
activities.correctAnswer: Sarajevo triggered the July Crisis, and alliance commitments plus mobilization widened the conflict into war.
activities.feedback: A complete answer links the assassination to the July Crisis and shows how alliances and mobilization spread the fighting beyond one event.

activities.label: Fix the chain
activities.title: Repair the outbreak chain
activities.body: Use this cue: one event did not stay local. Add the missing link that explains how the crisis widened.
activities.misconceptionSummary: The Sarajevo assassination alone caused the war immediately.
activities.concept: widening of the conflict through alliances and mobilization
activities.correctAnswer: The assassination started the July Crisis, and alliance commitments plus mobilization turned the crisis into a wider war.
activities.feedback: The key fix is to add the July Crisis and the way alliances and mobilization widened the conflict.

check.title: Europe before war
check.prompt: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions in Europe?
check.referenceAnswer: They split Europe into rival military blocs, so a crisis involving one power could pull in its allies.
check.feedback: The alliances increased the chance that a local conflict would spread.

items.essentialIdea: Sarajevo assassination prompted Austria-Hungary to confront Serbia, then wider war began.

check.title: From shooting to war
check.prompt: What chain of events followed the Sarajevo assassination?

check.feedback: The assassination triggered escalation from a local dispute to a general war.

methodBriefing.name: Feynman Technique
methodBriefing.what: Explain an idea in plain language, compare it with an accurate source, repair the gaps, and explain it again.
methodBriefing.why: Connecting steps, causes, and prior knowledge can expose shallow understanding and build a more useful mental model.
how: Study one concise explanation or example.
Close it and explain the idea in your own words.
Name the cause, relationship, or reason behind each important step.
Compare with the source, repair the explanation, then teach it back again without copying.

activities.label: Learn
activities.title: Europe before war
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: Prewar European alliances and tensions divided Europe into rival military blocs.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: Europe before war
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions in Europe?
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions divided Europe into rival military blocs.
activities.correctAnswer: They split Europe into rival military blocs, so a crisis involving one power could pull in its allies.
activities.feedback: The alliances increased the chance that a local conflict would spread.

activities.title: From shooting to war
activities.body: Read the explanation, then answer the next question from memory.

essentialIdeas: Sarajevo assassination prompted Austria-Hungary to confront Serbia, then wider war began.
Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 runs from war outbreak to armistice.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: From shooting to war
activities.body: What chain of events followed the Sarajevo assassination?
activities.concept: Sarajevo assassination prompted Austria-Hungary to confront Serbia, then wider war began.
activities.correctAnswer: Austria-Hungary moved against Serbia, and the conflict widened as major powers issued declarations of war.
activities.feedback: The assassination triggered escalation from a local dispute to a general war.

activities.label: Explain
activities.title: War timeline
activities.body: Which event marks the end of the basic 1914 to 1918 chronology?
activities.concept: Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 runs from war outbreak to armistice.
activities.correctAnswer: The armistice in 1918 marks the end of the war's basic chronology.
activities.feedback: The chronology begins with the war in 1914 and ends with the armistice in 1918.

activities.label: Repair
activities.title: Repair the first explanation
activities.body: Compare the first explanation with this verified reference: They split Europe into rival military blocs, so a crisis involving one power could pull in its allies. Correct the exposed relationship in your own words without copying the reference.
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions divided Europe into rival military blocs.
activities.correctAnswer: They split Europe into rival military blocs, so a crisis involving one power could pull in its allies.
activities.feedback: The alliances increased the chance that a local conflict would spread.

activities.label: Explain again
activities.title: Explain the corrected relationship again
activities.body: How did prewar European alliances shape tensions in Europe? Explain it again after the repair without copying the model or reference answer.
activities.concept: Prewar European alliances and tensions divided Europe into rival military blocs.
activities.correctAnswer: They split Europe into rival military blocs, so a crisis involving one power could pull in its allies.
activities.feedback: The alliances increased the chance that a local conflict would spread.

activities.label: Recall check
activities.title: Ending event in 1918
activities.body: Which event marks the end of the basic 1914 to 1918 chronology?
activities.concept: Recognition transfer: Basic chronology from 1914 to 1918 runs from war outbreak to armistice.
choices: The armistice in 1918
The Sarajevo assassination
The outbreak of war in 1914
The formation of rival military blocs
activities.feedback: That is the 1918 endpoint of the basic chronology.
